verdict.rationale: Remote documents a broad API. It covers creating every employment type through `POST /v1/employments` with dynamic per-country schemas, two-way sync of people, contracts and payroll inputs, OAuth access on behalf of companies, and webhooks. A CLI also covers employments, time off, expenses, payslips, departments, custom fields and webhook subscriptions. However, nothing claims or shows that the API matches everything the UI can do, and the MCP write tools are limited to employee self-service actions. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, evidence that admin and payroll-approval actions are available via the API, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none), and independent corroboration.
